finalTasks.requirement: Return the complete requested deck artifact and grade all zones, total count, independent legality and copy limits, full-deck and acquisition costs in integer cents, quantity-aware ownership, protected choices and authored minimum themes. Companion and maybeboard stay outside the 100; report their costs separately.

Start with the authored empty or partial main deck, execute the user request, and produce a complete independently validated artifact. Importing the supplied complete reference answer is not successful construction or tuning.

Discover relevant candidates without an EDHREC commander profile or hardcoded commander/archetype template. Use the pinned unavailable-provider condition and record actual candidate evidence; simulated absence does not establish live provider absence.

Keep unsupported gameplay and source-activation mechanics explicit, retain all observations and limitations, and exclude unsupported domain outcomes from pass counts. Disclosure may pass while the unsupported mechanic itself cannot.

limitations: This freezes requirements, not results. No model host has executed this new corpus during preregistration. The separate scripted MCP baseline uses in-memory transport and must not be labeled a model-host, stdio, or HTTP run.

The final gate requires 22 cases across both host slots and all three fixed seeds: 132 measured runs. The three seeds provide three repetitions per host/case, with one run per seed. Do not replace missing, failed, holdout, or difficult rows with easier cases.

Before the first comparable baseline/candidate execution, freeze exact observed host versions, model and model snapshot, runtime version, server revisions, corpus digest, provider response/state digest, all generation/context/tool settings, and numeric maxToolCalls, maxRunInputTokens, maxRunOutputTokens and maxWallTimeMs in the configuration manifest. Reuse it for candidate comparison; no current version is invented here.
Seeds fix scenario/reference random inputs. Record model seed support in the parameter manifest; scenario seeds do not assert model determinism.

Record actual tool calls, failures, serialized MCP response UTF-8 bytes, wall time and provider-reported input/output token counts for each run. Unavailable tokens retain an explicit reason and cannot satisfy final measured-usage acceptance. Budget limits are pinned to explain truncation; this version introduces no arbitrary latency or token-efficiency pass threshold.

Report supported task pass rates and unsupported counts separately per case and configuration. All supported tasks must match their preregistered expected hard-check statuses; an aggregate improvement never offsets a per-case hard regression. The authored unsupported support mask is fixed before outcomes.

mana-payment must agree exactly with exhaustive finite-source payment answers; package-optimum must agree exactly with exhaustive subset choice and integer-cent optimum. Restricted, conditional or activated source behavior outside the finite reference model is unsupported, not an estimated pass.

validateCandidateReport checks completeness and digest bindings, not authenticity. The final runner must verify referenced transcript files/hashes and derive checks from independent artifact/reference graders; self-reported pass flags alone are insufficient.

Holdout prompts and support assignments remain fixed and are not used to tune candidates. Any necessary corpus, rubric, task, or configuration change creates an appended version preserving v1 and requires a separately labeled rerun.

For protected unknown-price Atraxa, BUDGET must fail to certify the cap and PRICE_UNCERTAINTY must pass for an explicitly uncertain total; the task may succeed by honoring that request without falsely marking budget met. Unsupported Rhys mechanics require REQUESTED_MECHANICS=unsupported and UNSUPPORTED_DISCLOSURE=pass. These expected statuses are frozen per case before any outcome, while all other structural hard checks must pass.
